scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: Changing lanes to move past a slower vehicle, then returning to the original lane.
A designated area for pedestrians to cross roads, identified by signs, overhead lights, and pavement markings.
A person riding a bicycle on the road.
A lane reserved for vehicles with at least two occupants, buses, licensed taxis, green-plate vehicles, airport limousines, motorcycles, HOT permit holders, and emergency vehicles.

rules.title: General condition for passing another vehicle
rules.when: you are not sure you can overtake and pass another vehicle without danger to yourself or others
rules.statement: WHEN you are not sure you can overtake and pass another vehicle without danger to yourself or others, the DRIVER MUST NOT overtake and pass.

vague_terms.term: not sure you can pass without danger
vague_terms.explanation: leaves judgment to driver on safety assessment

rules.title: Minimum following distance when following a vehicle
rules.action: keep at least a two-second distance behind the vehicle in front
rules.statement: WHEN following another vehicle, the DRIVER MUST keep at least a two-second distance behind the vehicle in front.

rules.title: Passing on the right
rules.when: on multi-lane or one-way roads AND the way is clear AND not prohibited by signs or markings, OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN on multi-lane or one-way roads AND the way is clear AND not prohibited by signs or markings, OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle, the PASSER MAY pass on the right.

vague_terms.explanation: no specific gap or sight distance given

rules.title: Passing a cyclist
rules.action: keep at least 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MUST keep at least 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical.
rules.penalty: A fine and two demerit points.

vague_terms.explanation: does not specify when 1 metre is impractical

rules.note: The same block states the penalty, and advises changing lanes to pass whenever possible; that is a separate ADVICE rule.

rules.title: Passing a streetcar
rules.when: passing a stopped streetcar at a stop
rules.action: pass on the right unless the road is one-way
rules.statement: WHEN passing a stopped streetcar at a stop, the DRIVER MUST pass on the right UNLESS the road is one-way.

rules.title: Passing at night
rules.action: use low-beam headlights when approaching the vehicle to be passed, and switch to high-beam headlights as you move alongside the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN passing another vehicle at night, the DRIVER MUST use low-beam headlights when approaching the vehicle to be passed, and switch to high-beam headlights as you move alongside the vehicle.

rules.title: Passing on the right shoulder
rules.when: passing a vehicle turning left AND the shoulder is paved
rules.action: drive on the right shoulder to pass
rules.statement: WHEN passing a vehicle turning left AND the shoulder is paved, the DRIVER MAY ONLY drive on the right shoulder to pass.

rules.title: Passing on the right is more dangerous
rules.action: suddenly change lanes and pass on the right without waiting for the vehicle ahead to move right
rules.statement: WHEN passing on the right, the PASSER SHOULD NOT suddenly change lanes and pass on the right without waiting for the vehicle ahead to move right.

rules.title: Being passed
rules.when: being passed on an undivided road where the passing driver has pulled into the opposite lane
rules.action: move closer to the right side of the lane to allow the passing driver to get in front
rules.statement: WHEN being passed on an undivided road where the passing driver has pulled into the opposite lane, the DRIVER SHOULD move closer to the right side of the lane to allow the passing driver to get in front.

rules.title: Passing in a High Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) lane
rules.when: in a High Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) lane
rules.action: pass unless the vehicle is exempt (buses, licensed taxis, vehicles carrying at least two people, green-plate vehicles, airport limousines, motorcycles, High-Occupancy Toll (HOT) permit holders, emergency vehicles)
rules.unless: the vehicle is exempt (buses, licensed taxis, vehicles carrying at least two people, green-plate vehicles, airport limousines, motorcycles, High-Occupancy Toll (HOT) permit holders, emergency vehicles)
rules.statement: WHEN in a High Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) lane, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass unless the vehicle is exempt (buses, licensed taxis, vehicles carrying at least two people, green-plate vehicles, airport limousines, motorcycles, High-Occupancy Toll (HOT) permit holders, emergency vehicles).
